propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local Rebar checkout, native CLI/MCP binary, tracker worktree, or network access despite having GitHub connector read-only visibility, and existing agent guidance does not explain safe operations in this constrained environment.

Native ticket creation is impossible precisely when both the tracker-worktree dimension fails (no accessible tickets branch checkout) AND the network/remote dimension fails or the native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable.

A safe fallback requires generating a fully-formed NDJSON ticket payload conforming to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version: 1, agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status: open, description with Acceptance Criteria, parent_id if applicable) and reporting the exact capability gap without claiming persistence.

The only sanctioned exceptional import path is `rebar import` (not raw event-file injection or GitHub Contents-API writes), which accepts NDJSON projections, assigns fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, preserves source provenance via source_id, and is idempotent by source_id.

In dry-run mode, rebar import silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no warning and no counter increment; only already-imported records increment the skipped counter, making malformed records detectable only by comparing would_create + skipped against total NDJSON record count.

All writes to the tracker must use the lock-guarded append/commit path via native rebar commands; hand-authored tracker mutations or raw event-file edits violate the append-only invariant and are unsafe.
